description: HushMessenger for Messenger 580 (arm64 codes 346013387, 346013440, 346013442, 346013354 and 346013370). 27 patches. Two more builds supported, a switch to hide the app drawer icon, Allow screenshots on Android 14 and newer, and same-key Facebook builds trusted by Messenger. Source updates do not change installed apps. Fresh sign-in/recovery and live ad removal remain unverified.
